scenario.title: Doctrine: Grace and Matter
scenario.premise: Across eight desks, build and question arguments about evil, freedom, bodies and grace. Manuscripts answer other manuscripts; agreement is not the same as victory. A completed argument reconstructs its author’s position, not a proof of belief.

stage.title: Can knowing the good be enough?
stage.speaker: Augustine’s grace controversy · early fifth century
stage.motivation: A person knows the good and still fails to do it. An infant is brought for remission before making a choice. Augustine must answer both, without turning the human creature into something evil.
stage.travelText: Can knowing the good be enough?

things.label: The fault lies in choosing, not wounded flesh
Evil, for Augustine, is damage to created good
“The good that I would I do not.”
God gives capacity; law and example guide our choices
God kindles love within the human will
Infants too are baptized for the remission of sins
Adam’s first sin passes to the human family
